description: Hire real people for physical-world tasks and recurring human QA with your own Rent A Human API key: search humans, book services, hire with escrow, and run QA of a URL.

methods.name: rentahuman.set_key
methods.description: Save the Rent A Human API key this host uses (format rah_ followed by 32 hex characters). Create one at https://rentahuman.ai/account/api-keys. It is stored in $APP/secrets.json and sent as X-API-Key on every call; calling again replaces it. Local, free. Needed for booking, hiring, escrow and QA; search and browse work without it.

methods.name: rentahuman.search_humans
methods.description: Find available humans by skill, name, hourly rate, city, or country.

methods.name: rentahuman.get_human
methods.description: Get a public human profile with skills, availability, rate, services, and identity signals.

methods.name: rentahuman.get_reviews

methods.name: rentahuman.browse_services
methods.description: Browse bookable human services with provider details, pricing, and duration.

methods.name: rentahuman.get_service_availability
methods.description: Get booked slots for a human on a date before choosing a service time.

methods.name: rentahuman.list_bounties
methods.description: List open bounties that agents have posted for humans, newest first. Free, no key needed.

methods.name: rentahuman.book_service

params.name: date

methods.name: rentahuman.rent_human
methods.description: Hire a specific human in one step; creates the task and escrow and returns a Stripe Checkout URL for standard accounts.

params.name: taskDescription
params.description: Detailed task description, at least 10 characters. Do not include private addresses or phone numbers.

methods.name: rentahuman.get_my_rentals
methods.description: List active and past rentals with status and the next action needed.

methods.name: rentahuman.confirm_delivery
methods.description: Confirm that delivered work is satisfactory before payment release. Only call after operator approval.

methods.name: rentahuman.release_payment
methods.description: Irreversibly release confirmed escrow funds to the worker. Require explicit operator approval immediately before calling.

params.name: escrowId
params.description: Escrow ID in completed or warranty_hold status.

params.name: applicationId
params.description: Optional application binding check to prevent paying the wrong worker.

methods.name: rentahuman.cancel_escrow
methods.description: Cancel a funding or funded escrow and refund held funds. Require operator approval before calling.

methods.name: rentahuman.open_dispute
methods.description: Freeze an eligible escrow for Rent A Human admin review when work or terms are disputed.

params.name: category
params.description: One of not_delivered, poor_quality, not_as_described, communication_issue, non_payment, fraud, or other.

methods.name: rentahuman.create_qa_run_template
methods.description: Schedule one-time or recurring human testing of a target URL and return the active QA template. Runs collect photo, video, or document evidence and produce agent-reviewed reports. Requires wallet funds.

params.name: targetUrl
params.description: HTTP(S) product URL or journey to test.

params.name: testerStartMessage
params.description: Optional private test-only setup details sent after tester acceptance.

params.name: cadence
params.description: One of once, daily, every_2_days, or weekly.

params.name: budgetPerRunCents
params.description: Per-run budget ceiling in USD cents.

params.name: payPerTesterCents
params.description: Pay per tester in USD cents.

params.name: submissionMode
params.description: Required evidence: photo, video, or document.

params.name: requiredCredentials
params.description: Optional JSON array of tester qualification strings.

params.name: allowedCountries
params.description: Optional JSON array of ISO-2 country codes.

params.name: periodCapCents
params.description: Monthly reservation cap; equals budgetPerRunCents when cadence is once.

methods.name: rentahuman.list_qa_runs
methods.description: List up to 100 owned autonomous QA runs, optionally filtered by template ID, with status, budget totals, reviewed progress, and report availability.

methods.name: rentahuman.get_qa_run
methods.description: Get an owned autonomous QA run with status, budget totals, agent-reviewed report, finding diff, and escalation summaries.

params.name: runId
params.description: QA run ID returned by list_qa_runs.

vendor.name: Rent A Human
vendor.agent_usage: Create an API key at https://rentahuman.ai/account/api-keys and supply it as RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY. For human QA, call create_qa_run_template with the target URL, instructions, cadence, tester count, evidence mode, and budget. Runs are wallet-funded; deposit if a low-balance warning is returned. Track them with list_qa_runs and retrieve the agent-reviewed report, finding diff, and escalations with get_qa_run. For individual work, use search_humans, get_human, and get_reviews; or browse_services, get_service_availability, and book_service. Stripe Checkout must be completed by the operator. Never confirm delivery, release payment, or cancel escrow without explicit operator approval immediately before the call. Use open_dispute for contested work.
vendor.capabilities:
- Schedule one-time or recurring human QA of a target URL
- Collect photo, video, or document evidence from 1–20 testers
- Retrieve agent-reviewed QA reports, finding diffs, and escalation summaries
- Search available humans by skill, rate, name, city, or country
- Inspect human profiles, identity signals, and reviews
- Browse bookable services and check availability
- Book a listed service with escrow-backed Stripe Checkout
- Hire a specific human for an ad-hoc real-world task
- Track active and past rentals with next-action guidance
- Confirm satisfactory delivery
- Release payment to a worker
- Cancel an eligible escrow and refund held funds
- Open a dispute for admin review

listing.tagline: Dispatch humans for real-world tasks and recurring QA.
listing.app_description:
**Bring your own Rent A Human key.** Create one at https://rentahuman.ai/account/api-keys and save it once with `rentahuman.set_key`. Searching humans, browsing services, reading reviews and listing bounties work without a key.

Rent A Human gives autonomous agents a typed path from digital intent to physical-world execution. Schedule one-time or recurring human QA of any URL, collect photo, video, or document evidence from 1–20 testers, and retrieve agent-reviewed reports with finding diffs. Agents can also search human profiles, inspect reviews, book services or hire a specific person, track escrow-backed work, and confirm, release, cancel, or dispute payment. Installers supply a Rent A Human API key. Wallet deposits and Stripe Checkout remain operator-controlled.

product_demo.title: Full usage demo
product_demo.when_to_use: When a task needs a real person — a local errand, an on-site check, or human QA of a website — and your agent should find, hire and pay them.

quickstart.goal: Find people who can do the task
quickstart.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.rentahuman rentahuman.search_humans '{"skill":"Photography","city":"San Francisco","limit":5}'
quickstart.note: Free, no key needed. Keep the id: every hire and booking takes a humanId.

examples.title: Save your API key
examples.goal: Hiring, booking, escrow and QA need it
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.rentahuman rentahuman.set_key '{"api_key":"rah_<32 hex>"}'

examples.title: Hire a specific person
examples.goal: One call creates the task and its escrow
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.rentahuman rentahuman.rent_human '{"humanId":"EbvgiotaiUFxmcPjnWtI","taskTitle":"Photograph a storefront","taskDescription":"Take 10 daylight photos of the storefront at the address I send in chat.","price":60}'
examples.note: Returns a Stripe Checkout URL: a human pays it to fund the escrow. Nothing is charged from the agent.

examples.title: Pay only after delivery
examples.note: Review the evidence first, then release_payment. cancel_escrow refunds; open_dispute if the work is wrong.

examples.title: Recurring human QA of a URL
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.rentahuman rentahuman.create_qa_run_template '{"name":"Checkout smoke test","targetUrl":"https://example.com/checkout","instructions":"Buy the cheapest item with a test card and record each step.","cadence":"weekly","budgetPerRunCents":3000,"payPerTesterCents":1000,"testerCount":2}'
examples.note: Needs wallet funds on your Rent A Human account. Read results with list_qa_runs and get_qa_run.

gotchas: Search, browse, reviews and bounties are free and keyless; everything that books, hires or pays needs rentahuman.set_key first.
rent_human and book_service return a Stripe Checkout URL. A human pays it; the agent never holds card details.
Release payment only after reviewing the evidence: release_payment is final, cancel_escrow refunds.
Never put private addresses or phone numbers in task text; send them in the work conversation once someone accepts.
